name: Tess Greymane
guide_text: You can afford to stabilize on lower tiers and save HP so when you steal directional cards from your opponent you are healthy enough to play into them.
buddy_guide_text: Buddy for 5+ gold IF the opponent you're facing has a good buddy. You're willing to buddy up for even 7 gold if you're facing an AFK
